Response Response.reasoning: This header names the biological property (Body size) that was measured for the organism.
Response Response.reasoning_relevance: The example value 'Body size' names the trait being measured, indicating a measurement key.
Response Response.basisOfRecord_reasoning: The study measured specific morphological traits of ground beetles, namely average body size (species length) and wing typology (macropterous vs. brachypterous/apterous). These measurements were taken from specimens that were collected and preserved in absolute ethanol, classifying the data as being derived from preserved specimens.
Response Response.measurementMethod: Pitfall traps (plastic vials filled with 5% ethylene glycol) were used to sample ground beetles across 100 sites (25 per habitat type) during the dry season (October 25th to November 15th, 2019). Morphological traits (body size and wing typology) were determined by direct measurement of the collected and preserved specimens.
